name: 3D Experience — GLTF motorcycle model and interactive component hotspots load
description: Verifies that the Three.js 3D motorcycle canvas renders without error, the loading indicator clears, and hotspot selection buttons display component specs.

planSteps.description: Navigate to '/#bike-3d' and ensure the '#bike-3d' section is scrolled into view
The '#bike-3d' section is visible with header 'CLASSIC 350 / 3D EXPERIENCE' and heading 'THE MACHINE, UP CLOSE.'
The WebGL canvas inside '#bike-3d' is rendered without loading error and the control toolbar including '#btn-full-view' is visible
The five hotspot navigation buttons '#hotspot-btn-engine', '#hotspot-btn-exhaust', '#hotspot-btn-headlight', '#hotspot-btn-tank', and '#hotspot-btn-seat' are visible and present below the 3D canvas
The component details panel is visible displaying default engine specifications 'J-SERIES 349 CC' and 'AIR-OIL COOLED SOHC'
The component details panel updates to display exhaust specifications 'PEASHOOTER SILENCER' and 'TUNED BASS CADENCE'
The component details panel updates back to display engine specifications 'J-SERIES 349 CC' and 'AIR-OIL COOLED SOHC'
The '#btn-full-view' button indicates active state and the component details panel closes as the camera resets to full overview
